newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending Monday's loss.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending Monday's loss.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend Monday's 1.2-percent fall on Tuesday as demand remained stifled ahead of the public offering of copper giant KGHM Polska Miedz SA starting on June 30.
Analysts said the main market, currently at 15,862.6 points, should maintain its flat-to-down trend into next month.
They said National Investment Funds (NFIs) should extend the falls that followed mid-June's speculative surge but that a bottom was near.

Analysts also said metals trader Impexmetal, which starts trade on the main market on Tuesday, likely had debut upside potential of no more than 20 percent above its 36-zloty issue price and could open flat. -- Steven Silber +48 22 653 9700
